note: Last-mile backend-integration work items ('surfaces'). One row per surface the project actually has; skip a surface only by saying so in `notes`, never by deleting the row. Detail (if any) lives in state/integration/<id>.json. Ordered by blocks_level so the cheapest unblocking work comes first.

surfaces.title: Build-system integration
surfaces.what: Add a SYCL/XPU backend option to the project's own build so its own artifact is produced with the backend enabled.
surfaces.notes: ggml/src/ggml-sycl/CMakeLists.txt added; ggml_add_backend(SYCL) already existed in ggml/src/CMakeLists.txt (upstream scaffolding) and now finds a real subdirectory.

surfaces.title: Device runtime layer
surfaces.what: Implement the project's device abstraction over SYCL: device/context/queue(stream)/event/sync, error translation.
surfaces.notes: Device enumeration (level_zero:gpu), per-device in-order sycl::queue, USM device buffer type, backend/device/reg interfaces implemented in ggml-sycl.cpp + common.hpp.

surfaces.title: Allocator / memory manager
surfaces.what: Replace cudaMalloc / RMM / the caching allocator with a USM equivalent behind the project's own allocator interface.
surfaces.notes: Single-device USM device alloc/free/copy done (see 'runtime'). Multi-GPU split buffer waived (see readiness.json waivers). Host-pinned buffer deferred (residual).

surfaces.title: Registration & dispatch
surfaces.what: Make the project's own call path reach the migrated SYCL kernels (dispatch table, op registration, layer/graph factory).
surfaces.notes: ggml_sycl_compute_forward switch in ggml-sycl.cpp is the dispatch table; extended one op at a time during migrate. CPY/DUP/CONT + view-like ops registered so far.

surfaces.title: Host library call sites
surfaces.notes: oneMKL (SYCL) will back mul_mat (cuBLAS replacement); CMakeLists.txt already wires find_package(MKL) + MKL::MKL_DPCPP. No host CUB/Thrust equivalents needed yet (SYCL backend has no host-side CUB/Thrust call sites of its own).

surfaces.title: Packaging / import path
surfaces.what: Make the user-facing entry work: `import <pkg>`, the extension build, find_package/CMake export.
surfaces.notes: llama-cli/llama-perplexity/test-backend-ops already build and link the new backend via the existing ggml_add_backend(SYCL) hook -- no separate packaging surface for this C++ CLI application (archetype A); revisit if a Python binding is required.

surfaces.title: NVIDIA-only feature paths
surfaces.what: Stub or disable NVIDIA-only paths (OptiX/DLSS/TensorRT/NVML/OpenXR) and record a waiver with its blast radius for each.
surfaces.notes: The SYCL backend is hand-written from scratch (no ported CUDA-only code paths within ggml-sycl itself); nothing to waive here. CUDA-only code lives entirely in ggml-cuda/ which is simply not compiled when GGML_SYCL is selected instead of GGML_CUDA.
